title: The scuttle
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Monday. The beach at full scuttle. The pup's gait drawn as a rhythm across four panels — two-one, two-one — the strip learning the new animal's weight by learning its time signature.

panels.composition: The beach. BARNABY II at full speed along the tideline. The gait: front two, hind one. The prints behind him: two, one, two, one.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog running at full speed along a tideline leaving a trail of prints in a two-one rhythm, no words
image.notes: The prints are the point: two front, one hind, repeated. Draw them exactly.

panels.composition: Closer. The body's roll. The ears back. The joy of it drawn without a face doing joy.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog mid-stride with its body rolling and ears back, running with evident joy, no words

panels.composition: The prints only. Two, one. Two, one. To the panel's edge. A gull's prints crossing them once.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a trail of small three-legged dog prints in a two-one rhythm crossing wet sand with a gull's prints cutting across once, no words

panels.composition: WOOD far behind on the sand, walking, at the dog's old pace — the sixteen-year-old's — out of habit. The pup a dot ahead. The strip catching him at the wrong speed.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man walking slowly along a beach far behind a small dog that is a distant dot ahead, no words
image.notes: Wood at the old dog's pace. The strip doesn't say so.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Wordless. Two, one. Wood at the old dog's pace.
